rentals:10:1742483.title: Biff the Human Slayer

rentals:10:1748841.title: Dark Hollow

svod:8:1355228.title: Gandhari

svod:8:1744876.overview: A documentary film that observes, listens to, and interacts with Fito Páez from a place of profound intimacy. The camera, almost invisible, witnesses his every move, accompanying him for over a year during recordings, rehearsals, tours, and performances in major cities across Latin America, Europe, and the United States. It is also a journey through the life of one of the greatest Spanish-language artists: his loves and heartbreaks, children and friendships, excesses, tragedies, failures, and successes.
svod:8:1744876.title: Fito Páez: The World Within a Song

svod:8:1752159.overview: A quarter-century after September 11th, the attacks' ripple effects persist across generations. Orphaned children, War on Terror journalists, young Afghans, and U.S. Marines shaped by the 2021 withdrawal share their stories.
svod:8:1752159.title: Turning Point: Generation 9/11
